Australia/Sydney = UTC+10  
US/Hawaii = UTC-10  

Time difference = target_offset − source_offset = (-10) − (+10) = -20 hours  

8:00 − 20 hours = (8 − 20) = -12 hours → add 24 hours: 12:00 previous day.  

Date in Sydney: August 6, 1427 08:00 → Hawaii: August 5, 1427 12:00.  

FINAL_ANSWER: August 5, 1427 12:00
